무엇: SeoulMarkets 숏영상에 얹을 «대본». 화면(카드)이 말하는 것을 그대로 읽는다.
⛔ 지키는 것: 이 파일에 없는 말을 자가 지어내지 않는다. 화면 카드에 없는 수를 목소리로 말하지 않는다(카드 PNG 글자를 못 읽으니, 확실치 않으면 숫자를 빼고 질적 사실만 읽는다). 화면과 소리가 다르면 그 편이 신뢰를 깎는다.
⚠ 길이: 영상 길이 안에 들어가는 말만. make-seoulmarkets-video-sound.mjs 가 실제 목소리 길이를 재서 넘치면 멈춘다(화면을 늘이지 않고 말을 줄인다).

korea-kospi-swing-after-viral-close.내레이션: A Reddit post said KOSPI closed at 6,835.8, up 0.23%. We checked it — exactly right for that day. The next session, it fell 3.99%.
korea-kospi-swing-after-viral-close.설명: Korea Exchange daily closing data, verified against a viral social post. We checked the number, not the discussion — not investment advice.

korea-etf-premium-means-two-different-th.내레이션: A Korean ETF trading above its value usually falls back tomorrow. But for a synthetic fund tracking Asian stocks, the same premium predicts a gain instead. Same signal, opposite meaning.
korea-etf-premium-means-two-different-th.설명: FSC ETF price API, 629 trading days. We report the split, not a trading strategy — not investment advice.

korea-bigger-firms-pay-more-every-step.내레이션: In Korea, the bigger the company, the more it pays — and not only at the top. At every step up the size ladder, average pay rises. The gap between the smallest firms and the largest is not one jump. It builds, step after step.
korea-bigger-firms-pay-more-every-step.설명: Same establishment survey, all industries. We report the steps, not the reasons.

korea-female-workforce-share-by-sector.내레이션: In Korea, women are about 57 percent of the staff at apparel firms — and just 8 percent at steelmakers. Across listed companies the median is 24 percent. Where women work splits hard by sector, far more than how many work.
korea-female-workforce-share-by-sector.설명: Listed firms' own disclosures. We report where, not why.

korea-how-long-industries-keep-workers.내레이션: How long does a Korean industry keep the people it hires? Weight each firm by headcount and the range is wide. Carmakers hold their workers about sixteen years. Research firms keep them under four.
korea-how-long-industries-keep-workers.설명: From listed firms' own filings. We rank, we do not explain.

korea-company-vs-owner-wage.내레이션: In Korea, working for a company pays about a quarter more than working for an individual owner. The national pension bills roughly 370,000 won a month for the average company worker, against 280,000 for those working for a sole proprietor.
korea-company-vs-owner-wage.설명: From national pension billing. We measure the gap, not the cause.

korea-headcount-disclosure-has-no-total-.내레이션: Every listed Korean company files a yearly headcount table. It carries no total. One in three files the count in pieces, leaving the reader to add. Read only the first row — as we did — and hundreds of thousands vanish. We made that mistake, and fixed it.
korea-headcount-disclosure-has-no-total-.설명: From company filings on DART. This piece is our own correction — we report what we could not measure, and what we got wrong.

korea-everything-comes-down-to-four.내레이션: One number keeps coming back in Korea. Rank its stocks by value, or its trading partners by exports — the top four are about half, every time. Every score sits above nine-tenths, more top-heavy than any income gap. Not advice.
korea-everything-comes-down-to-four.설명: Shares and Gini only, computed the same way across market and trade. We show the shape, not the reasons — and this is not advice.

korea-analysts-stopped-saying-hold.내레이션: In Korea, brokers almost never say sell — 89 sell calls in twelve years. The real change is the hold rating: it fell from one report in ten to one in thirty. The middle is disappearing. We count, we don't judge.
korea-analysts-stopped-saying-hold.설명: From 55,580 rated broker reports since 2014. We count the calls, we do not judge them.

korea-bond-trading-six-issues.내레이션: Korea's bond market puts a price on hundreds of bonds — but barely trades them. On one day, six bonds were ninety percent of all trading; government benchmarks, ninety-five. A market that prices everything and trades almost nothing. We count, not advise.
korea-bond-trading-six-issues.설명: Trading-value shares for one measured day. We count what actually traded — this is not advice.

korea-largest-listed-companies.내레이션: How many companies are listed in Korea, and which are the largest by market value? We count them from the exchange's own list. And we call market value capital intensity, not productivity.
korea-largest-listed-companies.설명: The full ranking and method are on Seoul Markets dot com.

korea-convertible-dilution-discount.내레이션: In Korea, converting debt into shares creates new stock at a 24 percent discount to the market. A cash raise discounts only 12 percent. We checked companies that used both routes in the same period — the convertible still cut deeper.
korea-convertible-dilution-discount.설명: From DART filing and closing-price data since 2020. Not investment advice.

korea-four-stocks-half-the-market.내레이션: Rank Korea's stocks by market value and a handful at the top hold about half of everything. Every way we measure it, the same few names dominate.
korea-four-stocks-half-the-market.설명: But market value is capital intensity, not productivity. The full data is on Seoul Markets dot com.
